subtype: Cutting corners in a group task [Actor]
passage:
Pankaj: Village 5 row is blank. Due in two hours.
Urmila: Only 18 of 30 forms came back there.
Pankaj: Then we write 18 and explain.
Urmila: I will put 27. Everyone pads a number sometimes. It is one cell.
Pankaj: I do not love that.
Urmila: Nobody checks. Sending.
(Next day, 9:10 a.m.)
Pankaj: Sir, our course professor, wants the raw forms for village 5 by tonight.
Urmila: I only have 18. My stomach just dropped.
Pankaj: Tell him before he counts. I will come with you.
Urmila: Okay. It was one cell, but I wish I had left it at 18.

qa.q: How many forms came back from the fifth village?
qa.a: Eighteen of the thirty forms came back.

qa.q: What was Urmila feeling when Sir asked for the raw forms?
qa.a: Panicked and guilty, since Urmila's stomach dropped and the wish to have left it at 18 shows regret.

qa.q: What could Urmila do after Pankaj's offer?
qa.a: Tell the professor before the forms are counted and correct the figure with an honest explanation.

qa.q: How might Pankaj have felt about the padded number, then and now?
qa.a: Uneasy at the time, since Pankaj said not loving it, and now supportive, offering to go along.

grounding: Illustrates a student who invents a data point to meet a deadline, excuses it with everyone does it, and faces the consequence.

subtype: Cutting corners in a group task [Actor]
passage: At the small-town college near Sangli, the projector cast the poster onto the wall, and the judge asked, "Who wrote the water-testing method?" Avni had known the question was coming. Ira had spent three nights on that method in the library, and her name was not on the poster; Avni had typed only "submitted by Avni and team". "I led it," Avni said, and told herself that teams do this all the time. The judge nodded. Ira, standing at the back with the sample bottles, looked at the floor and said nothing. On the walk to the bus stand Ira stayed three steps behind. "You could have said my name," she said at last, and Avni had no answer that felt true.

qa.q: What did Ira spend three nights on in the library?
qa.a: Ira spent three nights on the water-testing method.

qa.q: What was Avni feeling on the walk to the bus stand?
qa.a: Guilty and stuck for words, because Avni had no true answer.

qa.q: What could Avni do next to repair things?
qa.a: Tell the judge and organisers that Ira wrote the method, and apologise to Ira.

qa.q: How might Ira feel about being left off the poster?
qa.a: Hurt and overlooked, since she stayed silent and three steps behind.

grounding: Illustrates a student who lets a team member's uncredited work pass as the team's own, softening it with everybody does it.
